verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no published pricing for Gram, whether per tool call, per connection, or by plan, and no documented rate limits. The cost-tracking and spend-dashboard items (gram-gh-1, gram-docs-25) describe monitoring the customer's own AI usage spend, which is an adjacent feature rather than transparent platform pricing, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see transparent pricing per tool call or connection plus documented rate limits before committing to the platform
